chunks: Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal عليه السلام said:
"Take a nap, for Allah, Mighty and Majestic, feeds the fasting person and gives him drink in his sleep."

key_terms.قِيلُوا: Take a midday nap or rest

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal عليه السلام say about sleeping while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages the fasting person to rest, indicating that sleep during fasting is accompanied by divine care and provision. It highlights Allah’s mercy toward the fasting person and the spiritual dignity of the state of sawm.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Take a nap, for Allah (swt), the Almighty, feeds and gives drink to the fasting person while they sleep."
